text_block_list.text:
One day, while watching Narita Brian's 
dance training...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That should do it. Even if it's 
just a sideshow to the race, I can't 
afford to look pathetic out there.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! You're so good at dancing, 
Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Mayano, is it? I'm in the middle of a 
lesson right now. Do not disturb me."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okaaay. Soooorry.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but wait, Maya might've just found 
Brian-san's weakness♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: My weakness, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You know, I think you're not smiling 
enough♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I am smiling. Just like the 
choreography dictates, I offer a smile 
whenever it's required.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san looks scary with a normal face, 
so I think she needs to smile with a big 
grin♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You certainly don't mince words... 
However, I will pass. It is not needed.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, it's totally necessary~! Right, 
Trainer? You think so too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't listen to them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't listen to them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, what a contrary bastard...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~♪ Then Maya will practice 
smiling with you♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I never said I'd do it.
choice_data_list: It's for the sake of an even better dance!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, you want me to smile?! Fine, I'll 
smile!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: How's that? Smiling is nothing to me...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, how should I put it... The dancing 
is super sharp, but...
choice_data_list: Your expression is super sharp, too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? I'm not angry. I should be 
smiling!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Don't be mad. Smile, smile♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I told you, I'm not angry!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I am angry, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Looks like Maya will just have to 
coach you personally every step of the 
way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey... give me a break.

Afterward, through some intense smile 
training under Mayano Top Gun's passionate 
instruction, it seems she managed to get 
the hang of it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~? Why not~?
choice_data_list:
Brian's known for her cool smile, after 
all

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't really planning on selling it, 
though... Well, let's just leave it at 
that.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Maya doesn't get it. What do you 
mean? I don't have to smile...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, smiles come in all kinds, you know... 
You'll understand once you've grown up a 
bit more.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? So if I understand it, that means 
I'm a grown-up!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
W-Why did your eyes suddenly light up like 
that...?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya gets it! I'm gonna stay right here 
and study Brian-san's "coolness"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I won't get in your way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As long as you stay out of my way, fine... 
Do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! So that's what being "cool" is all 
about! I'm learning so much~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Mm, mmm... Somehow, this feels awkward to 
do...

However, being conscious of their gazes 
resulted in a crisper, sharper dance 
practice than usual.
